, for a given network scenario, asynchronous duty-cycled protocols outperform synchronized duty-cycled protocols in terms of throughput and delay performance, while synchronized duty-cycled protocol outperforms asynchronous duty-cycled protocol in terms of energy consumption.

, in a network with a small number of nodes (e.g., 10 nodes) and a high traffic load, a synchronized duty-cycle MAC protocol such as S-MAC is preferred, whereas in a network with large number of nodes (say, 100 nodes) and a low traffic load, an asynchronous duty-cycle MAC protocol, e.g., X-MAC, should be preferred.
